items.name: sheet
items.label: Sheet
items.description: The page itself: one specimen sheet on a ruled desk, hairline edged, with room in the margin.

items.name: block
items.label: Numbered block
items.description: A section with its plate number out in the margin and a dotted leader running down beside it.

items.name: card
items.label: Card
items.description: A panel on the sheet. Inset for something quieter, mark for the one that matters.

items.name: cmd
items.label: Command row
items.description: A line meant to be copied, with the button that copies it. Dark for a terminal, pale for a sentence you paste to an assistant.

items.name: steps
items.label: Steps
items.description: A numbered sequence where the order is the instruction.

items.name: table
items.label: Table
items.description: Ruled rows, mono headers, no fills.

items.name: stage
items.label: Stage
items.description: The dark inset media sits in: 3D, a terminal, a chart on ink.

items.name: button
items.label: Button
items.description: One hot-ink button per screen; everything else is quiet.

items.name: chip
items.label: Chip
items.description: A small tag for state, time or category.

items.name: field
items.label: Field
items.description: Text input with a mono label above it.

items.name: swatch
items.label: Swatch
items.description: A colour specimen: the chip, the token name, the live value.

items.name: type
items.label: Type
items.description: Monospaced display, system sans body. The scale is seven sizes and no more.
